messages.en:
{07 00 00}It feels like I've been sick
for forever. {07 16 00}I felt so
lonely, 'cause I live alone.
Plus, I didn't have any
{ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00}, and was too sick
to go get some.
But {07 00 00}{ff 00 00 05}{04 10 00} {ff 00 00 00}was nice
enough to come by every
day to check on me.
{07 14 00}I was reminded{01 00 00 05 00} of how
important friends are,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tundub, et olen igavesti
haige olnud. {07 16 00}Mul oli nii
üksi, sest ma elan üksinda.
Pealegi polnud mul
{ff 00 00 07}rohtu{ff 00 00 00} ja olin liiga haige,
et seda tooma minna.
Aga {07 00 00}{ff 00 00 05}{04 10 00} {ff 00 00 00}oli nii kena,
et tuli iga päev
mind vaatama.
{07 14 00}See tuletas mulle meelde,{01 00 00 05 00}
kui tähtsad on sõbrad,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}The other day, I{01 00 00 05 00} was sick
as a dog. {07 00 00}I had a fever, a
cough, and was so dizzy.
{07 16 00}The only thing I remember 
is that {ff 00 00 05}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} brought
me some {ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Üleeile olin ma{01 00 00 05 00} haige
nagu koer. {07 00 00}Mul oli palavik,
köha ja pea käis ringi.
{07 16 00}Ainus, mida ma mäletan,
on see, et {ff 00 00 05}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} tõi
mulle {ff 00 00 07}rohtu{ff 00 00 00}!

{07 16 00}Kui ma olin haige ja
õnnetu, {ff 00 00 05}{07 14 00}{04 10 00} {ff 00 00 00}tuli
iga päev {ff 00 00 07}rohuga{ff 00 00 00},
et näha, kas olen korras.
{07 19 00}See oli nii armas, et isegi
mina läksin liigutatuks!{07 14 00}
